title: C 909 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: C 909 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: C 909 corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety. About 100 days to harvest, 7.6 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: C 909 corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 1996 as NSIC 1996 Cn 77. Cargill Seeds bred it. It takes about 100 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 7.62 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

rows: Both the wet and the dry season

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

C 909 corn takes about 100 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 3.5 days faster than the average of the 215 yellow hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 103.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 7.62 t/ha beats the average of its group, 7.17. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It was weak against rust, so scout for it from the early weeks. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn planthopper](/pests/corn-planthopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant C 909 corn

It is recommended for anywhere in the country in both the wet and the dry season. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).
